*PharmaCraft Daily - 26 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (General Pharmacology)
Q: First-order kinetics means a constant ______ of drug is eliminated per unit time.
Ans: fraction
Why: In first-order kinetics a constant FRACTION is eliminated per unit time; most drugs follow this.

🌍 *FMGE* (General Pharmacology)
Q: Drugs that induce liver enzymes will ______ the metabolism of other drugs.
Ans: increase
Why: Enzyme inducers (rifampicin, phenytoin) increase metabolism, lowering levels of co-administered drugs.

🩺 *NEET PG* (General Pharmacology)
Q: Which phenomenon explains greater drug effect when two drugs give a response larger than the sum of each?
Ans: Synergism (potentiation)
Why: Synergism/potentiation is a combined effect greater than the sum of individual effects.

🏥 *INI-CET* (General Pharmacology)
Q: A noncompetitive antagonist differs from a competitive one in that it?
Ans: Lowers the maximal response (not surmountable)
Why: Noncompetitive antagonism reduces the maximal response and cannot be overcome by more agonist.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper I: General/Experimental)
Q: CPCSEA guidelines in India regulate?
Ans: Care and use of laboratory animals
Why: CPCSEA oversees the ethical care and use of animals in research in India.
